_comment: Gesture vocabulary for presenter_02.mp4 (trimmed from source 4.0-13.0s).
Windows located with scripts/segment_gestures.py, then named by eye.
This presenter gestures almost continuously - the motion profile's median is
1.63 against presenter_01's 0.69 - so there is no truly still pose to use as
neutral. 'hands_together' is the calmest passage rather than a motionless one,
which suits a presenter who talks with their hands and would look wrong frozen.
Roles: neutral (resting), present (open/explanatory, used on core facts),

hands_together.note: hands held together at chest, small steady motion; the calmest stretch

open_hands.note: hands drawn apart, palms open - the explanatory beat

quick_fingers.note: faster, tighter finger movement; reads as insistent
